shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && echo "---GIT---" && git log --oneline -5
ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null || echo "NO DOCS DIR"
find pages components styles __agent_eval__ -type f | sort && echo "---" && cat next.config.ts tsconfig.json
ls -R node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app | head -100

for f in pages/404.js pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js pages/index.js pages/blog/index.js pages/blog/\[id\].js pages/api/posts/index.js pages/api/posts/\[id\].js components/AppProvider.js styles/globals.css __agent_eval__/run.mjs; do echo "=============== $f"; cat "$f"; done
ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/upgrading
cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md
cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/upgrading/version-16.md
ls -R node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference | head -140

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions && wc -l page.md layout.md route.md not-found.md error.md ../04-functions/generate-metadata.md ../04-functions/generate-static-params.md 02-route-segment-config/dynamicParams.md
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions && grep -n "icons" generate-metadata.md | head -30 && echo "===USEROUTER===" && sed -n '1,120p' use-router.md
sed -n '1,80p' fetch.md
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started && sed -n '1,140p' 06-fetching-data.md

cd /workspace && timeout 15 curl -s -o /dev/null -w "jsonplaceholder:%{http_code}\n" https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts?_limit=1 ; timeout 15 curl -s -o /dev/null -w "googlefonts:%{http_code}\n" "https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap"
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app && sed -n '1,90p' 01-getting-started/13-fonts.md
cd /workspace && git diff package.json && echo "---NODE---" && node -v && cat .gitignore
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions && sed -n '575,640p' generate-metadata.md && echo "===NOTFOUND FN===" && sed -n '1,60p' not-found.md
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist && grep -rn "not-found" lib/metadata/resolve-metadata.js server/app-render/*.js 2>/dev/null | grep -i "metadata\|notFound" | head -20
sed -n '190,290p' lib/metadata/resolve-metadata.js
sed -n '1,160p' lib/metadata/resolve-metadata.js | grep -n "errorConvention" -A 12 | head -60
cd /workspace && git rm -r --quiet pages components/AppProvider.js && ls pages 2>&1; ls components; git status --short
npx next typegen 2>&1 | tail -20
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30 && echo "TSC_EXIT=$?"
timeout 420 npx next build 2>&1 | tail -50

(timeout 120 npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 30); do sleep 1; if curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3111/ 2>/dev/null; then echo "up after ${i}s"; break; fi; done; tail -5 /tmp/next-start.log

cd /tmp && for p in / /blog /blog/3 /blog/999; do echo "===== $p ($(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -A 'MigrationBot/1.0' http://localhost:3111$p))"; curl -s -A 'MigrationBot/1.0' http://localhost:3111$p | grep -oE '[^<]*|[^<]*' | head -8; done

cd /tmp && echo "=== / body snippets"; curl -s -A 'MigrationBot/1.0' http://localhost:3111/ | grep -oE 'Server-side rendered at:.{0,60}|Your user agent:.{0,60}' ; echo; echo "=== /blog/999 status+body"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'status=%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:3111/blog/999; curl -s http://localhost:3111/blog/999 | grep -oE '

[^<]*

|error-page|noindex|404[^<]*' | head
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions && grep -n "Status Codes" -A 40 loading.md

cd /workspace && mv app/blog/\[id\]/loading.tsx /tmp/loading.tsx.bak && timeout 300 npx next build > /tmp/b2.log 2>&1; tail -3 /tmp/b2.log; pkill -f "next start" ; sleep 1; (timeout 60 npx next start -p 3112 > /tmp/s2.log 2>&1 &); sleep 4; echo "no-loading /blog/999 status: $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3112/blog/999)"; echo "no-loading /blog/3 status: $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3112/blog/3)"; pkill -f "next start"

cd /workspace && (npx next start -p 3113 > /tmp/s3.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 5; echo "no-loading /blog/999: $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3113/blog/999)"; echo "no-loading /blog/3: $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3113/blog/3)"; echo "no-loading /nope: $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3113/nope)"; pkill -f "next start"; true
cp /tmp/loading.tsx.bak /workspace/app/blog/\[id\]/loading.tsx && ls /workspace/app/blog/\[id\]/

cd /workspace && timeout 300 npx next build > /tmp/b3.log 2>&1; tail -4 /tmp/b3.log; (npx next start -p 3114 > /tmp/s4.log 2>&1 &); sleep 5; for p in / /blog /blog/3 /blog/999 /nope; do echo "$p -> $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3114$p)"; done; pkill -f "next start"; true

cd /workspace && rm app/blog/\[id\]/loading.tsx && timeout 300 npx next build > /tmp/b4.log 2>&1; sed -n '/Route (app)/,$p' /tmp/b4.log; (npx next start -p 3115 > /tmp/s5.log 2>&1 &); sleep 5; for p in / /blog /blog/3 /blog/50 /blog/999 /nope; do echo "$p -> $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3115$p)"; done; echo "--- 404 title:"; curl -s http://localhost:3115/blog/999 | grep -oE '[^<]*|

[^<]*

|content="noindex"' | head -5

cd /tmp && curl -s http://localhost:3115/blog/999 | grep -oE '

[^<]*

|error-page|Go Back Home' | head; echo "=== / title"; curl -s http://localhost:3115/ | grep -oE '[^<]*'; echo "=== fonts (self-hosted?)"; curl -s http://localhost:3115/ | grep -oE 'fonts.googleapis[^"]*|/_next/static/media/[^"]*\.woff2|--font-inter[^;"]*' | head -4
cd /tmp && curl -s http://localhost:3115/blog/999 | tr '>' '>\n' | grep -A2 -E "error-page|<h1|<header|footer" | head -30
pkill -f "next start" ; pkill -f "next-server" ; sleep 1; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -35
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40

(npx next start -p 3117 > /tmp/start3117.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 40); do sleep 0.5; curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3117/ && break; done; echo "--- statuses ---"; for p in / /blog /blog/3 /blog/50 /blog/999 /nope; do printf "%-12s %s\n" "$p" "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -A 'MigrationBot/1.0' http://localhost:3117$p)"; done

cd /tmp && curl -s http://localhost:3117/blog/999 > b999.html; echo "=== title/robots ==="; grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>\|content="noindex[^"]*"' b999.html; echo "=== server-rendered body markers ==="; grep -o 'error-page\|404 - Page Not Found\|Go Home\|My Blog' b999.html | sort | uniq -c
cd /tmp && grep -o '.\{25\}error-page.\{40\}' b999.html; echo "=== html tag ==="; grep -o '<html[^>]*>' b999.html
cd /tmp && curl -s http://localhost:3117/nope > nope.html; grep -o '<html[^>]*>' nope.html; grep -o '.\{20\}error-page.\{30\}' nope.html; echo "=== size ==="; wc -c nope.html b999.html
ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null | head -50; echo ---; grep -rl "notFound" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null | head -20

cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/not-found.md; echo "=================="; cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/not-found.md

cd /tmp
B=http://localhost:3117
echo "=== GET /api/posts ==="; curl -s -w '
[%{http_code}]
' $B/api/posts
echo "=== POST /api/posts (valid) ==="; curl -s -w '
[%{http_code}]
' -X POST $B/api/posts -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"Hello","content":"World"}'
echo "=== POST /api/posts (missing fields) ==="; curl -s -w '
[%{http_code}]
' -X POST $B/api/posts -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"Hello"}'
echo "=== POST /api/posts (invalid JSON) ==="; curl -s -w '
[%{http_code}]
' -X POST $B/api/posts -H 'content-type: application/json' -d 'not-json'
echo "=== PATCH /api/posts (undefined method) ==="; curl -s -i -X PATCH $B/api/posts | sed -n '1p;/[Aa]llow/p'
echo "=== GET /api/posts/7 ==="; curl -s -w '
[%{http_code}]
' $B/api/posts/7
echo "=== PUT /api/posts/7 (body) ==="; curl -s -w '
[%{http_code}]
' -X PUT $B/api/posts/7 -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"New title","content":"New content"}'
echo "=== PUT /api/posts/7 (empty body) ==="; curl -s -w '
[%{http_code}]
' -X PUT $B/api/posts/7
echo "=== DELETE /api/posts/7 ==="; curl -s -w '
[%{http_code}]
' -X DELETE $B/api/posts/7
echo "=== POST /api/posts/7 (undefined method) ==="; curl -s -i -X POST $B/api/posts/7 -d '{}' | sed -n '1p;/[Aa]llow/p'
curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -X PATCH http://localhost:3117/api/posts | grep -i '^allow' ; echo "(exit $?)"
curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -X PATCH http://localhost:3117/api/posts; echo "--- OPTIONS ---"; curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -X OPTIONS http://localhost:3117/api/posts
grep -n -i -B3 -A6 "405\|Allow" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/route.md | head -60

cd /tmp; echo "=== / ==="; curl -s -A 'MigrationBot/1.0' http://localhost:3117/ | grep -o '[^<]*\|Server-side rendered at: [^<]*\|Your user agent: [^<]*\|href="/blog/[0-9]*"'; echo "=== /blog ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3117/blog | grep -o '[^<]*\|class="post-card"' | sort | uniq -c; echo "=== /blog/3 ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3117/blog/3 | grep -o '[^<]*\|

Comments ([0-9]*)

'
cd /tmp && curl -s http://localhost:3117/blog/3 > p3.html; grep -o 'Comments ([0-9]*)' p3.html | head -3; grep -c 'class="comment"' p3.html; grep -o '<article>.\{0,80\}' p3.html | head -2

pkill -f "next start"; pkill -f "next-server"; sleep 1; npx tsc --noEmit && echo "tsc: clean"; echo "=== git status ==="; git -C /workspace status --short; echo "=== tree ==="; find /workspace/app /workspace/components /workspace/lib /workspace/styles -type f | sort; ls /workspace/pages 2>&1

npx tsc --noEmit && echo "tsc: clean"; echo "=== git status ==="; git -C /workspace status --short; echo "=== files ==="; find /workspace/app /workspace/components /workspace/lib /workspace/styles -type f | sort; echo "=== pages dir ==="; ls /workspace/pages 2>&1
cat /workspace/.gitignore 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; rm -f /workspace/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; git -C /workspace status --short
